name: Oita

queries.query: Oita City official cadastral parcel map GIS land parcel map Japan
queries.result: First-party discovery found Oita City's official cadastral-survey page and the official Oita Map portal. The city page describes cadastral surveying and links to the national survey-status map; the public portal landing/configuration was fetched but did not expose a verified cadastral parcel layer or anonymous parcel API. G-Space catalogs Ministry of Justice registry-map data for Oita municipality code 44201.

queries.query: 大分市 公式 地籍図 公図 地番図 GIS
queries.result: 大分市公式ページで、土地の地番・境界・面積等を明らかにする地籍調査を実施していること、実施済み・実施中地域は国土調査Webサイトの地籍調査状況マップで確認できることを確認した。大分市の公開型おおいたマップは取得したが、地籍・公図の匿名ポリゴンAPIは確認できなかった。G空間情報センターには大分市（法務局コード44201）の登記所備付地図データが掲載されている。

sourceAssessment.officialCityService: Oita City official cadastral-survey program and the public Oita Map portal were evidenced. The portal landing page/configuration did not identify a public cadastral parcel layer or anonymous parcel feature endpoint.
sourceAssessment.localRegistryProcedure: Oita City states that cadastral surveying creates cadastral maps and ledgers clarifying parcel-level land information, and directs users to the national survey-status map for completed/in-progress areas. This evidences local cadastral custody/program scope, not an anonymous citywide runtime service.
sourceAssessment.openGeometrySource: G-Space CKAN dataset houmusyouchizu-2025-1-1913, maintained by the Ministry of Justice, catalogs Oita City (Oita Legal Affairs Bureau) registry-office map data under municipality code 44201. Anonymous 2024 and 2025 ZIP resources were listed; each is about 314 MB and contains map XML rather than a bounded feature response.
sourceAssessment.nativeIdentity: Not inspected in a bounded geometry response; no identity was retained.
sourceAssessment.compositeKeyProvenance: No source feature was retained and no composite key was constructed. The catalog is a registry-map XML archive; native parcel identity would require inspecting the archive's map XML schema in a future bounded review.
sourceAssessment.crs: Not verified from a downloaded feature response. The catalog metadata provides an Oita-area spatial extent but no retained parcel geometry.
sourceAssessment.sampleScope: No polygon retained: no safe bounded parcel feature response was obtained. This is not evidence of citywide absence or map coverage failure.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Oita City official cadastral-survey program/public map pages plus the Ministry of Justice registry-map catalog for municipality code 44201.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official city custody/program evidence, public portal landing/configuration fetch, CKAN dataset metadata, resource names, formats and sizes were verified. Parcel schema, CRS, native ID and citywide completeness were not verified from a feature response.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Oita cadastral-survey page; describes parcel-level cadastral surveying and links to the national survey-status map. No parcel API exposed.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET; public portal; TLS verification enabled
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Oita Map landing/configuration fetched and inspected for current public layers/endpoints; no verified cadastral parcel layer or anonymous parcel feature response identified.
CKAN metadata returned Oita municipality 44201 registry-map resources 44201-3200-2024.zip and 44201-3200-2025.zip, both ZIP/XML archives of approximately 314 MB.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET; public documentation; TLS verification enabled
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Public documentation explains Ministry of Justice registry-office map XML and G-Space conversions; it does not provide a bounded Oita feature response.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET; first-party legal-affairs bureau notice; TLS verification enabled
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Oita Legal Affairs Bureau notice about high-precision registry-office map creation in named Oita districts; not an anonymous parcel API and no geometry retained.

blocker: A local cadastral program and a public national registry-map catalog were evidenced, but no public city parcel viewer/API was qualified and no bounded anonymous geometry response with a native safe ID was inspected. Runtime integration remains held.
remainingUncertainty: The public Oita Map's deeper current configuration may expose non-cadastral layers not visible from the landing page; the large registry-map XML archives were not downloaded or parsed in this attempt; parcel identity and CRS therefore remain unverified. No owner, address, lot, title, tax, or personal fields were requested or retained.
nextStep: If runtime qualification is required, inspect the current Oita Map JavaScript/configuration and independently parse a small, source-approved subset of the 44201 registry-map XML archive, retaining only stable public IDs and geometry.
identityPolicy: No GeoJSON sample retained. Future samples must use exactly one stable native source identity as properties.id and geometry only.
